# Rachid Chabane

> AI engineering blog and portfolio, in French and English. Long-form articles, a daily radar of sourced briefs, a personal journal and open-source projects. Every text is a plain HTML page with its sources listed.

## Sections

- [Articles (EN)](https://rachid-chabane.com/en/blog/): long-form pieces on agents, evaluation, security and infrastructure
- [Articles (FR)](https://rachid-chabane.com/fr/blog/)
- [Radar (EN)](https://rachid-chabane.com/en/radar/): short sourced briefs on what just shipped
- [Radar (FR)](https://rachid-chabane.com/fr/radar/)
- [Journal (EN)](https://rachid-chabane.com/en/journal/): dated personal ideas
- [Journal (FR)](https://rachid-chabane.com/fr/journal/)
- [Projects (EN)](https://rachid-chabane.com/en/work/)
- [Library (EN)](https://rachid-chabane.com/en/library/): every text, and definitions of the terms used
- [About (EN)](https://rachid-chabane.com/en/about/)
